Terms of service

Acme gives your team a workspace for plans, documents and tasks. You keep every right to what you put in it; we only process it to run the service.

A trial lasts 14 days and ends by itself. A paid plan renews monthly and can be cancelled at any time, effective at the end of the month.

Questions about these terms go to legal@acme.example.

Privacy policy

We store your name, your email address and what your team writes in Acme - in data centres in the European Union.

We never sell your data and never use it to train models. Logs that could identify you are deleted after 30 days.

You can export or delete everything at any time; privacy@acme.example answers within a week.
